title: World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to Know
summary: Unlike the text-based nature of large language models , world models use visual inputs and can generate digital environments that simulate physics. McClendon sees these world models as helping robots practice without physical movement or being in intended environments.
